text: 狗咬吕洞宾，不识好人心
pinyin: gǒu yǎo lǚ dòng bīn, bù shí hǎo rén xīn
literal: dog · bite · Lü Dongbin, not · recognise · good · person's · heart
natural: A dog bites Lü Dongbin, not recognising a kind heart

meaning.en: Someone fails to recognise a good intention and turns on the person trying to help.
meaning.zh: 不识好歹，把别人的好心当作恶意。

equivalents: Bite the hand that feeds you

examples.zh: 我好心提醒你，你却不领情，真是狗咬吕洞宾，不识好人心。
examples.en: I warned you out of kindness and you took it badly; that's biting the hand that helps you.

examples.zh: 狗咬吕洞宾，不识好人心，下次再也不管他了。
examples.en: He doesn't know a good deed when he sees one; I'll never help him again.

usage.en: Said in annoyance at ingratitude; Lü Dongbin is one of the Eight Immortals. Often said by the wronged person about themselves.
usage.zh: 遇到好心不被理解时的抱怨，吕洞宾是八仙之一。

pinyin: qián pà láng, hòu pà hǔ
literal: front · fear · wolf, back · fear · tiger
natural: Afraid of the wolf in front and the tiger behind

meaning.en: To be so timid and hesitant that one dares not act.
meaning.zh: 顾虑太多，畏首畏尾。

equivalents: Between the devil and the deep blue sea

examples.zh: 做事不能前怕狼，后怕虎，要大胆一点。
examples.en: You can't be afraid of every danger; be bolder.

examples.zh: 他前怕狼，后怕虎，机会就这样错过了。
examples.en: Fearing risks on every side, he let the chance slip by.

usage.en: Criticises over-caution; sometimes used for a no-win situation.
usage.zh: 批评瞻前顾后，有时指两头为难。

pinyin: rén féng xǐ shì jīng shén shuǎng
literal: person · meet · happy · event · spirit · refreshed
natural: Spirits are high when a person meets happy news

meaning.en: Good news lifts your spirits and makes you look and feel energetic.
meaning.zh: 遇到喜事，人心情舒畅，精神饱满。

equivalents: Good news makes you walk on air

examples.zh: 人逢喜事精神爽，他中奖以后整天笑呵呵的。
examples.en: Good news lifts the spirits; since winning a prize he's been smiling all day.

examples.zh: 人逢喜事精神爽，妈妈看上去年轻了好几岁。
examples.en: Happy news has lifted Mum's spirits; she looks years younger.

usage.en: Often paired with 闷上心来瞌睡多. Used at celebrations.
usage.zh: 常与“闷上心来瞌睡多”对举，用于喜庆场合。

pinyin: míng shī chū gāo tú
literal: famous · teacher · produce · outstanding · pupil
natural: A famous teacher produces outstanding pupils

meaning.en: A great teacher turns out great students.
meaning.zh: 好老师能教出优秀的学生。

equivalents: A good teacher makes a good student

examples.zh: 名师出高徒，她的老师是国家级的钢琴家。
examples.en: A great teacher makes great pupils; her teacher is a national pianist.

examples.zh: 名师出高徒，这支队伍的教练可是世界冠军。
examples.en: Great coaches make great athletes; the coach is a world champion.

usage.en: Often a compliment to teacher and student; sometimes said with a hint of 'it depends on the student too'.
usage.zh: 多用于夸赞师徒，也有“还要看徒弟自己”之意。

pinyin: qiáng jiàng shǒu xià wú ruò bīng
literal: strong · general · under · no · weak · soldier
natural: A strong general has no weak soldiers

meaning.en: A capable leader trains capable subordinates.
meaning.zh: 能干的领导手下不会有无能的人。

equivalents: A good captain makes a good crew

examples.zh: 强将手下无弱兵，这位经理带出来的团队个个能干。
examples.en: A strong general has no weak soldiers; every member of the manager's team is capable.

examples.zh: 强将手下无弱兵，主教练一来球队就脱胎换骨。
examples.en: A good coach produces good players; the team was transformed when he arrived.

usage.en: Used about leaders and teams in business, sport and military. Pinyin 将 is jiàng 'general'.
usage.zh: 多用于领导与团队关系。将读jiàng，指将领。

pinyin: tān duō jiáo bù làn
literal: greedy · much · chew · not · mushy
natural: Too greedy for much, can't chew it up

meaning.en: Taking on too much means you can't do any of it properly.
meaning.zh: 一次吃得太多嚼不烂，比喻学习做事贪多就不精。

equivalents: Bite off more than you can chew
Jack of all trades, master of none

examples.zh: 学语言要循序渐进，贪多嚼不烂。
examples.en: Learn a language step by step; if you bite off too much you can't digest it.

examples.zh: 他同时报了五个班，结果贪多嚼不烂，哪个也没学好。
examples.en: He signed up for five classes at once and, biting off more than he could chew, learned none of them.

usage.en: Advice to the over-ambitious learner.
usage.zh: 常用来劝学习做事要精不要滥。

pinyin: yǎn bù jiàn wéi jìng
literal: eye · not · see · count as · clean
natural: What the eye doesn't see counts as clean

meaning.en: If you don't see something unpleasant you needn't be bothered by it.
meaning.zh: 没看见就当干净，不用在意。

equivalents: What you don't know can't hurt you
Out of sight, out of mind

examples.zh: 餐馆的后厨我不看，眼不见为净。
examples.en: I won't look at the restaurant's kitchen; what the eye doesn't see is clean.

examples.zh: 房间乱就乱吧，眼不见为净。
examples.en: Let the room be messy; out of sight, out of mind.

usage.en: Typically said while overlooking something unhygienic or unpleasant. Related but distinct from 眼不见，心不烦.
usage.zh: 多用于不愿看脏乱之处，与“眼不见，心不烦”相近但不同。

pinyin: zhēn rén bù lòu xiàng
literal: true · person · not · show · appearance
natural: The true master doesn't show his face

meaning.en: Truly capable people don't flaunt their ability.
meaning.zh: 真正有本事的人不炫耀，从外表看不出来。

equivalents: Real masters keep a low profile

examples.zh: 原来这位老先生就是大师，真是真人不露相。
examples.en: So this old gentleman is the master; truly, real experts don't show off.

examples.zh: 真人不露相，他平时低调，没想到是个高手。
examples.en: Real talent stays hidden; he's always modest, but turns out to be an expert.

usage.en: Usually said in surprise at discovering hidden talent. 露 is read lòu here (colloquial).
usage.zh: 多用于惊讶地发现他人深藏不露的本领。

synonyms: 行家一出手，便知有没有

text: 天下无难事，只怕有心人
pinyin: tiān xià wú nán shì, zhǐ pà yǒu xīn rén
variants: 世上无难事，只怕有心人
literal: under heaven · no · difficult · matter, only · fear · have · heart · person
natural: Nothing under heaven is hard, only a determined person to fear

meaning.en: Nothing is impossible for someone with determination.
meaning.zh: 世上没有做不成的事，只要肯用心坚持。

equivalents: Where there's a will there's a way

examples.zh: 天下无难事，只怕有心人，他用三年时间学会了编程。
examples.en: Nothing is impossible to the determined; he learned programming in three years.

examples.zh: 天下无难事，只怕有心人，坚持下去就能成功。
examples.en: Where there's a will there's a way; persevere and you'll succeed.

usage.en: Motivational and widely taught; 世上无难事 is a variant.
usage.zh: 励志格言，常见于教育场合。

pinyin: qiáng zhōng zì yǒu qiáng zhōng shǒu
literal: strong · among · naturally · have · strong · among · hand
natural: Among the strong there are always stronger hands

meaning.en: However good you are, someone else is better.
meaning.zh: 再强的人，也有比他更强的。

examples.zh: 强中自有强中手，别太骄傲了。
examples.en: There is always someone better; don't be too proud.

examples.zh: 强中自有强中手，他在全国赛上输给了更厉害的对手。
examples.en: There's always a stronger hand; he lost to a better opponent in the national contest.

usage.en: Often paired with 能人背后有能人. A humbling reminder.
usage.zh: 常与“能人背后有能人”连用，劝人谦虚。

antonyms: 山中无老虎，猴子称大王

pinyin: guì rén duō wàng shì
literal: noble · person · much · forget · matters
natural: Distinguished people forget a lot

meaning.en: Said humorously or sarcastically of someone who has forgotten something.
meaning.zh: 身份高的人记性不好，多用来讥讽或打趣别人忘事。

equivalents: Your memory is as good as ever, I see

examples.zh: 您真是贵人多忘事，上周才答应过我的。
examples.en: You really are forgetful; you promised me only last week.

examples.zh: 贵人多忘事，你把我的生日又忘了。
examples.en: Typical of a busy VIP; you forgot my birthday again.

usage.en: Sarcastic or playful; do not use for real respect.
usage.zh: 多用于调侃或讥讽，不是真的尊敬。

pinyin: nǚ dà shí bā biàn
literal: girl · grow · eighteen · changes
natural: A girl changes eighteen times as she grows up

meaning.en: A girl's looks change greatly as she grows up.
meaning.zh: 女孩子从小到大，相貌、性格变化很大。

equivalents: The ugly duckling becomes a swan

examples.zh: 女大十八变，小时候的丑小鸭现在成了大美女。
examples.en: Girls change a lot as they grow; the ugly duckling is now a great beauty.

examples.zh: 女大十八变，我差点认不出你了。
examples.en: Girls change so much; I almost didn't recognise you.

usage.en: Usually a compliment on someone's transformation; often followed by 越变越好看.
usage.zh: 多用于夸赞，常接“越变越好看”。

pinyin: bù shì yuān jia bù jù tóu
literal: not · is · enemies · not · gather · together
natural: If they weren't enemies, they wouldn't come together

meaning.en: People who keep bickering are destined to end up together.
meaning.zh: 互相纠缠不清的人，往往注定要在一起。

examples.zh: 他们吵了一辈子，不是冤家不聚头。
examples.en: They have quarrelled all their lives; they were meant to be together.

examples.zh: 不是冤家不聚头，这对欢喜冤家终于结婚了。
examples.en: Bickering lovers end up together; the pair finally married.

usage.en: Often playful about couples; 冤家 may mean 'rivals' or 'sweethearts'.
usage.zh: 多半戏谑，冤家可指对头，也可指爱人。

pinyin: huà bù tóu jī bàn jù duō
variants: 酒逢知己千杯少，话不投机半句多
literal: words · not · agree · half · sentence · too many
natural: If conversation clicks not, half a sentence is too many

meaning.en: When you don't share views with someone, even a few words are too many.
meaning.zh: 谈不到一块儿，多说一句也嫌多。

equivalents: We have nothing to say to each other

examples.zh: 你我话不投机半句多，再谈下去也没有意思。
examples.en: If we can't agree even a word more is too many; there's no point talking further.

examples.zh: 酒逢知己千杯少，话不投机半句多，他们俩话没说几句就散了。
examples.en: Wine with a friend is never too much, but with a stranger a word is too many; the two parted after a few remarks.

usage.en: Often paired with 酒逢知己千杯少; first half praises good company.
usage.zh: 常与“酒逢知己千杯少”对举。

pinyin: wú guān yī shēn qīng
literal: no · office · whole · body · light
natural: Without office, the whole body is light

meaning.en: Leaving a position of responsibility brings freedom and ease.
meaning.zh: 没有官职的拖累，浑身轻松。

equivalents: Free as a bird now that I'm off the hook

examples.zh: 退休了，无官一身轻，天天去钓鱼。
examples.en: Retired and free of duties, he goes fishing every day.

examples.zh: 无官一身轻，他辞职后感觉特别自在。
examples.en: Free of office, he felt relaxed after resigning.

usage.en: Often used humorously about retirement or resigning; sometimes with 有子万事足.
usage.zh: 多用于退休、辞职，常与“有子万事足”连用。

pinyin: shā jī yān yòng niú dāo
literal: kill · chicken · why · use · ox · knife
natural: Why use an ox-cleaver to kill a chicken?

meaning.en: Don't use a big method or a talented person for a small task.
meaning.zh: 杀鸡不需要用宰牛的大刀，比喻小题大做。

equivalents: Don't use a sledgehammer to crack a nut

examples.zh: 这点小事，何必劳驾总经理，杀鸡焉用牛刀。
examples.en: Why bother the general manager with this little matter? It's using a sledgehammer to crack a nut.

examples.zh: 让博士去做数据录入，真是杀鸡焉用牛刀。
examples.en: Making a PhD do data entry is overkill.

story.en: Confucius visited Wucheng, heard music and smiled: 'Why use an ox-knife to kill a chicken?' (to govern a small town with ritual and music).
story.zh: 孔子到武城，听到弦歌声，笑着说：“割鸡焉用牛刀？”

usage.en: Can be a modest refusal ('this is beneath me') or a complaint about waste of talent. 焉 is yān.
usage.zh: 可作谦辞，也可指大材小用。

pinyin: dú mù bù chéng lín
literal: single · tree · not · form · forest
natural: A single tree doesn't make a forest

meaning.en: One person alone can't accomplish great things; cooperation is needed.
meaning.zh: 一个人力量有限，成不了大事，需要大家合作。

equivalents: One swallow doesn't make a summer

examples.zh: 独木不成林，想做成这件事，必须靠大家的力量。
examples.en: A single tree doesn't make a forest; this will take everyone's efforts.

examples.zh: 独木不成林，他一个人开公司很难撑下去。
examples.en: One man can't do it alone; he'll struggle to keep the company going alone.

usage.en: Stresses teamwork; often paired with 孤掌难鸣.
usage.zh: 强调合作，常与“孤掌难鸣”连用。

pinyin: rén shēng qī shí gǔ lái xī
literal: human · life · seventy · ancient · come · rare
natural: Few have lived to seventy since ancient times

meaning.en: Reaching seventy has always been rare, so cherish the time you have.
meaning.zh: 活到七十岁自古以来就不多见。

equivalents: Three score and ten is a ripe old age

examples.zh: 人生七十古来稀，爷爷七十大寿，全家都来祝贺。
examples.en: Reaching seventy is rare; the whole family came to celebrate Grandpa's seventieth birthday.

examples.zh: 人生七十古来稀，现在八九十岁的人也不少见了。
examples.en: Seventy used to be rare, but now many people live to eighty or ninety.

story.en: Du Fu wrote: 'Wine debts are common wherever I go; few live to seventy since ancient times.'
story.zh: 杜甫《曲江二首·其二》：“酒债寻常行处有，人生七十古来稀。”

usage.en: Quoted at birthdays; the origin of 古稀 for age seventy.
usage.zh: 常用于祝寿，“古稀”指七十岁即源于此。

pinyin: bā zì hái méi yī piě
literal: character 八 · still · not yet · one · stroke
natural: Not even the first stroke of the character 八 has been written

meaning.en: A matter has barely begun and is far from settled.
meaning.zh: 事情还没有眉目，离成功还远。

equivalents: Don't count your chickens before they're hatched

examples.zh: 他们的合作八字还没一撇，别急着宣布。
examples.en: The collaboration hasn't really got started; don't rush to announce it.

examples.zh: 买房的事八字还没一撇，先别告诉爸妈。
examples.en: Nothing's settled about the house yet; don't tell Mum and Dad.

usage.en: Used to cool someone's excitement; 撇 is the left-falling stroke of 八.
usage.zh: 用于劝人别过早乐观，撇指汉字笔画。

pinyin: jiǔ hàn féng gān yǔ
literal: long · drought · meet · sweet · rain
natural: Long drought meets sweet rain

meaning.en: A welcome relief or happy event after a long wait.
meaning.zh: 久旱后遇到及时雨，比喻盼望已久的事终于实现。

examples.zh: 干了三个月旱，终于下雨，真是久旱逢甘雨。
examples.en: After three months of drought it finally rained; it was a blessed relief.

examples.zh: 苦等多年，终于升职，如同久旱逢甘雨。
examples.en: After years of waiting, his promotion came like rain after a drought.

usage.en: Part of a classic list of four joys: 久旱逢甘雨，他乡遇故知，洞房花烛夜，金榜题名时.
usage.zh: 出自“四大喜事”之说：久旱逢甘雨，他乡遇故知，洞房花烛夜，金榜题名时。

pinyin: dǎ shé dǎ qī cùn
literal: hit · snake · hit · seven · inches
natural: To hit a snake, hit it seven inches from its head

meaning.en: Strike at the critical point to be effective.
meaning.zh: 打蛇要打在要害处，比喻做事要抓住关键。

equivalents: Hit the nail on the head

examples.zh: 谈判要打蛇打七寸，抓住对方的软肋。
examples.en: In negotiations, go for the weak spot and strike at the critical point.

examples.zh: 打蛇打七寸，解决问题要找准关键。
examples.en: Strike where it matters; to solve a problem find its crux.

usage.en: Used for strategic precision; sometimes ruthless in tone. 七寸 is the snake's heart.
usage.zh: 强调抓关键，有时语气较狠。七寸指蛇的要害。

text: 大水冲了龙王庙，一家人不认一家人
pinyin: dà shuǐ chōng le lóng wáng miào, yī jiā rén bù rèn yī jiā rén
literal: great · flood · wash away · Dragon King · temple, one · family · people · not · recognise · one · family · people
natural: The flood washed away the Dragon King's temple; the family didn't recognise its own

meaning.en: Said when people who should be on the same side clash by mistake.
meaning.zh: 自己人互相不认识而发生冲突或误会。

examples.zh: 原来是同行，真是大水冲了龙王庙，一家人不认一家人。
examples.en: So we're in the same trade; we've mistakenly clashed with our own people.

examples.zh: 大水冲了龙王庙，一家人不认一家人，闹了个大误会。
examples.en: The flood washed out the Dragon King's temple; relatives failed to recognise each other and caused a misunderstanding.

usage.en: Usually said with a laugh after discovering the misunderstanding; the short form 大水冲了龙王庙 is also used.
usage.zh: 发现误会后笑着说，常简说前半句。

pinyin: yī dài bù rú yī dài
literal: one · generation · not · as good as · one · generation
natural: Each generation is worse than the last

meaning.en: Quality or ability declines from one generation to the next.
meaning.zh: 一代比一代差。

examples.zh: 老师傅感叹现在的年轻人一代不如一代。
examples.en: The old craftsman sighs that young people are worse with each generation.

examples.zh: 这个品牌的产品质量一代不如一代。
examples.en: The quality of this brand's products declines with every generation.

usage.en: Often used by older people; the opposite is 长江后浪推前浪, 一代更比一代强.
usage.zh: 多为老年人感叹，反义为“一代更比一代强”。

synonyms: 黄鼠狼下豆鼠——一辈不如一辈

text: 人往高处走，水往低处流
pinyin: rén wǎng gāo chù zǒu, shuǐ wǎng dī chù liú
literal: person · toward · high · place · walk, water · toward · low · place · flow
natural: People go up, water flows down

meaning.en: It is natural for people to seek better opportunities.
meaning.zh: 人们总想到条件更好的地方去，这是天性。

examples.zh: 人往高处走，水往低处流，他想去大城市发展也很正常。
examples.en: People aim higher as water flows downward; it's natural that he wants to develop in a big city.

examples.zh: 人往高处走，水往低处流，换工作争取更好的待遇没什么错。
examples.en: Everyone looks for better prospects; there's nothing wrong with changing jobs for better pay.

usage.en: Used to justify ambition or job-hopping; neutral.
usage.zh: 多用来为追求上进或跳槽辩解。

pinyin: shàn yǒu shàn bào, è yǒu è bào
literal: good · have · good · reward, evil · have · evil · retribution
natural: Good receives good reward, evil receives evil retribution

meaning.en: Good deeds are rewarded and bad deeds are punished.
meaning.zh: 做好事会有好结果，做坏事会遭报应。

examples.zh: 善有善报，恶有恶报，不是不报，时候未到。
examples.en: Good is repaid with good and evil with evil; if it hasn't happened yet, the time hasn't come.

examples.zh: 他一生行善，真是善有善报，恶有恶报。
examples.en: He did good all his life; truly good is repaid with good.

usage.en: Frequently quoted with 不是不报，时候未到. Reflects Buddhist and folk belief in karma.
usage.zh: 常接“不是不报，时候未到”，反映佛教与民间因果观。

antonyms: 好人不长命，祸害遗千年
